description: This PHP file is part of the TestLink open-source project. It manages the generation and display of test result matrices, including exporting data to spreadsheets and email attachments. It contains functions for building data sets, configuring UI components, and rendering complex test result tables, specifically tailored for test plan reports.

classes.name: tlExtTable
classes.description: An external class used for rendering rich ext-js tables in the UI.

classes.name: tlHTMLTable
classes.description: An external class used for rendering HTML tables.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks user permissions for test plan metrics.

methods.name: buildMatrix
methods.description: Builds an external JS rich table to display matrix results.

methods.name: buildMailCfg
methods.description: Builds email configuration object for test report emails.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Initializes GUI variables, loads test project and plan info, and sets up display options.

methods.name: createSpreadsheet
methods.description: Generates an Excel spreadsheet with detailed test results and handles email attachment or download.

methods.name: setUpBuilds
methods.description: Prepares build set data for report generation.

methods.name: buildDataSet
methods.description: Creates the data set for test case metrics to be displayed in the report.

methods.name: initLblSpreadsheet
methods.description: Initializes label strings used for spreadsheet column headers.

methods.name: initStyleSpreadsheet
methods.description: Defines styles for Excel spreadsheet formatting.

methods.name: setCellRangeSpreadsheet
methods.description: Creates an array with Excel cell range column identifiers.

methods.name: xlsStepOne
methods.description: Initializes the spreadsheet with header labels and style.

methods.name: initCols
methods.description: Initializes column configuration for the test result table based on platform display.
